verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Cast all your cares on Me
'Cause I care for you
I care for you

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
All your fountains are in Me
And I have everything you need
Just keep coming back to Me

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Those who call upon My name
They will not be put to shame
Just keep coming back to Me

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
Come to Me if you're weary
And I'll give you rest
I'll give you rest

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
My yoke is so easy
And My burden is less
My burden is less
